source: ClassPad.net, exact PLUS model selected; visible LCD SVG pixels and native key presses
observations: Observed on exact fx-880BTG PLUS. Initialize All and all subsequent settings/key presses are included per frame.
UnitV(3,4) gives (0.6,0.8); Angle((3,4),(-4,3)) gives 90 degrees. Switching to Radian retains 90 until EXE, then shows 1.570796327 on a new answer row.
UnitV of the zero vector and inverse of singular [1,2;2,4] report Math ERROR; determinant of that singular matrix is 0.

Determinant of a 2x3 matrix and addition of differently sized matrices report Dimension ERROR; Vietnamese label is Lỗi kích thước. Back preserves the expression and positions the cursor at the offending postfix/closing delimiter.
Successive scalar EXE results occupy rows 14,28,42. On the fourth result the expression scrolls away; four result rows remain at 0,14,28,42. The fifth retains four visible rows.
